title: A Protocol for the Asset
premise: Theo Coldharbour, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed — until the safe house is listed for sale with photos of the inside, and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. The listing is bait from Meridian, the covert program that trained Theo as a deniable asset and now wants its loose end recovered before a treaty checkpoint shift change seals the border for good. To survive, Theo must burn Meridian's network from the inside, trading the four identities that kept them alive for one true name they barely remember. The story ends at the checkpoint: Meridian dismantled, Theo crossing under their birth name — a stranger to themselves, finally free.
about_author: Sable Yarrow is a former intelligence analyst turned novelist who writes about the machinery of power from the inside. They live under no aliases at all, and find this endlessly disappointing.

chapters.title: The House That Sold Itself
chapters.summary: Theo, living as 'Mara Voss', discovers the safe house listed online — every room photographed, including the hidden room. POV: Theo. Emotional beat: cold dread; the life built on anonymity collapses in a single scroll.

chapters.title: Four Names, One Pulse
chapters.summary: Theo inventories their identities and escape routes while a buyer's agent circles the property. Flashback fragments of training surface unbidden. POV: Theo. Emotional beat: paranoia sharpening into resolve — someone wants them found.

chapters.title: Open House
chapters.summary: Theo attends the open house disguised as a buyer and recognizes the 'agent' as Callum Reyes, a Meridian handler who once ran their cover rotations. POV: Theo. Emotional beat: vertigo of seeing the past wearing a name tag.

chapters.title: What Meridian Made
chapters.summary: Reyes offers a deal: come in, and the network stays quiet; refuse, and the other three names go public. Theo flees, triggering a dead-drop protocol from the old days. POV: Theo, with a brief Reyes interlude. Emotional beat: the leash tightening.

chapters.title: The Archivist
chapters.summary: Theo seeks Ines Okafor, a disgraced records clerk who keeps Meridian's off-book files. Ines reveals the training program's codename: PROTOCOL. POV: alternating Theo/Ines. Emotional beat: reluctant alliance; two damaged people recognizing each other.

chapters.title: Name Three Dies
chapters.summary: Theo's identity 'Jonas Reiter' is burned publicly — an obituary, a criminal record, a life weaponized. Theo watches their own legend get dismantled in real time. POV: Theo. Emotional beat: grief for a self that was never real.

chapters.title: Checkpoint Arithmetic
chapters.summary: Ines decodes the schedule: the border checkpoint shifts change in nine days, after which Meridian's jurisdiction — and Theo's window — closes. POV: Ines. Emotional beat: the clock becomes a character.

chapters.title: The Handler's Confession
chapters.summary: Reyes, off-script, meets Theo and admits Meridian is purging its own assets to bury PROTOCOL before an oversight review. He wants out too. POV: Reyes. Emotional beat: the enemy revealed as another asset on a leash.

chapters.title: Muscle Memory
chapters.summary: Ambushed at a dead drop, Theo's training takes over — brutal, efficient, horrifying. They incapacitate two retrieval teams and hate how easily the body remembers. POV: Theo. Emotional beat: identity horror; the asset waking up.

chapters.title: The Room with the Photos
chapters.summary: Theo breaks into the sold safe house and finds the hidden room stripped — except for a child's drawing they don't remember making. POV: Theo. Emotional beat: memory as crime scene; the past is closer than the present.

chapters.title: Ines's Ledger
chapters.summary: Ines hands over the network map: eleven handlers, four safe houses, one director — 'the Gardener'. Theo must choose which names to burn first. POV: Ines. Emotional beat: power's architecture laid bare, and its rot.

chapters.title: Name Two Sings
chapters.summary: Using identity 'Elise Brandt', Theo infiltrates a Meridian front charity and plants a false ledger that will force internal suspicion. POV: Theo as Elise. Emotional beat: the strange thrill of weaponizing a false self.

chapters.title: The Gardener's Garden
chapters.summary: First sight of Director Halvard Vane, tending an actual garden, delivering a chilling monologue about pruning assets. He knows Theo is watching. POV: Vane. Emotional beat: power as horticulture; corruption as care.

chapters.title: Betrayal in the Stacks
chapters.summary: Ines is taken by Meridian's retrieval unit; her archive is seized — except the copy she hid in Theo's coat an hour earlier. POV: Theo. Emotional beat: guilt, fury, and the cost of trusting anyone.

chapters.title: Name One, Last Rites
chapters.summary: Theo deliberately burns their primary identity, 'Mara Voss', flooding the network with her death to buy confusion — and to become, briefly, no one at all. POV: Theo. Emotional beat: liberation and terror of unbeing.

chapters.title: Reyes's Choice
chapters.summary: Reyes feeds Meridian false checkpoint intel, knowing it ends him. He gives Theo the Gardener's schedule and one sentence: 'You signed the first page yourself.' POV: Reyes. Emotional beat: redemption priced in blood.

chapters.title: The First Page
chapters.summary: The archive copy reveals the founding document of PROTOCOL — signed by Theo at nineteen, consenting to become an asset. They volunteered. POV: Theo. Emotional beat: the floor drops out; complicity is the cruelest memory.

chapters.title: Nine Days Become One
chapters.summary: The shift change moves up. Theo, nameless and hunted, plans the final burn: leak everything to three journalists, three jurisdictions, simultaneously. POV: Theo. Emotional beat: cold clarity; grief converted to method.

chapters.title: Burning the Network
chapters.summary: The leak detonates: handlers arrested, safe houses exposed, the charity front raided. Meridian eats itself alive. POV: multi-POV montage. Emotional beat: catharsis — power's machinery jammed by its own paperwork.

chapters.title: The Gardener's Last Pruning
chapters.summary: Vane corners Theo at the archive's ashes, offering restoration: one name, a clean legend, a promotion. Theo refuses and records him confessing. POV: Theo and Vane. Emotional beat: the corrupt bargain refused at last.

chapters.title: Checkpoint
chapters.summary: Dawn at the border. Shift change. Vane's people converge; Ines, freed in the chaos, holds the line with the journalists' evidence. Theo walks through under their birth name. POV: Theo. Emotional beat: climax — crossing as an act of self-creation.

chapters.title: One Name
chapters.summary: Weeks later, Theo — one name now, real and unlisted — helps other ex-assets burn their handlers' networks. The drawing from the hidden room hangs framed. POV: Theo. Emotional beat: quiet resolution; identity rebuilt from choice, not protocol.
